title: Questions?
slide_intent: Close a reference book with one clear next action. An isolated contact line keeps the reader from searching back through the policy pages.
strategic_value: Slack can make the end of the book recognizable with the same aubergine field used for section breaks.
demonstration: A small white question sits above a thin rule. The 2020 brand-inquiry contact appears directly beneath it on the left, with the rest of the page open.
practical_value: Use the final page as a reference for the placement and hierarchy of a contact route. Verify current contact details before reusing them.

content_islands.name: Closing question
content_islands.spec: Place the short heading near the top-left margin on the full aubergine field. Run a fine pale rule beneath it.

content_islands.name: Inquiry contact
content_islands.spec: Stack the inquiry prompt and email address beneath the rule, aligned with the heading. Keep the remainder of the field clear.
